# Drinks and water recipes
Mix the listed reagent units in a container. Heat recipes with a minimum temperature requirement. Scavenged bottled drinks without a mixing recipe are not listed as craftable.
## Water
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u filtered water
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 373 K (99.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u water.
## Filtered water
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u charcoal + 1u dirty water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u filtered water.
## Dirty water
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u Abraxo Cleaner + 1u irradiated water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u dirty water.
## Water
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u salt water
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 374 K (100.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u water, 1u table salt.

[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u agave nectar extract + 1u water

[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u agave tea.
